title: fuel hedge makes AirAsia worst
desc: Low-cost carrier AirAsia X Bhd (KL:AAX) is paying a steep price for its wrong-way bet on jet fuel. Management’s decision not to hedge when oil was cheap has backfired after the Iran war, and the company is now the worst-performing airline stock in the world.
